selection_provenance.selection_rule: After the pilot returned no formally eligible candidate, its sole observed interaction window was fixed for a separate follow-up; reported frequencies use only 32 new blocks.
selection_provenance.disclosure: The window had one complete pattern replication and one pattern-consistent but invalid replication with a missing payment-only intervention after a pre-intervention checkout restart. Pilot observations are excluded from the follow-up result.

analysis.primary_estimand: P(all three single conditions safe and joint unsafe | all four points valid)
analysis.invalid_block_sensitivity: count each invalid attempted block as a non-pattern
